what: Hand-drawn icons scattered in the margins (bird·cup·ball·house) each wiggle at their own tempo — the default type shrinks to .7x with no in-between frames (steps), flips and returns, twice at 5% and 15% of a cycle, pop swells to 1.05x then settles, swing shakes ±8°→0 then stands still, swing-step·swing-half nod twice in steps at −10°, flip-y flaps at 90° on the Y axis then unfolds, jump·hop flatten then leap up 1.5x·.5x their own height and land squashed (the kids on the footer hill), and spin turns a full rotation over 60% of the cycle. Giving each icon a staggered --fx-dur like 6.5·7.5·10·12.5s keeps them from moving at the same time

options.look: pop: bounceIn — 1.05x at 7%, alternate · cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1), bottom-center origin
options.look: jump: poyooon — at 13% it rises 150% of its own height, then lands squashed at 1.15×.8
options.look: hop: poyooon2 — at 10%, rises to 50% of its own height
options.--fx-dur: Length of one rotation (style) — original staggers each icon at 4~13s
options.--fx-origin: Rotation axis (style), default center (pop · jump · hop use the bottom)

use: …
